strings.다름이 아니고, 최근에 이상한 데이터들이 초시공 네트워크로 흘러들러오고: Recently, some unusual data has been flowing into the Hyperspace Network.
strings.분명 데이터는 모험가님으로 인해 발생된 것이라 인식하고 있지만, 제가 알: The network identifies it as data generated by you, Adventurer, yet some of it does not belong to the adventurer I know...
strings.아마도 이건 여러 세계, 여러 기억을 가진 모험가님의 흔적. 초 시공 네: I believe these are traces of you from different worlds, with different memories. Instability in the Hyperspace Network seems to have caused several unusual phenomena.
strings.다른 모험가가 행동을 하면, 기록으로 남아 모험가님께서 확인할 수 있습니: When another adventurer does something, it remains as a record that you can view. Likewise, when you do something, another adventurer will be able to view that record...
That's a little hard to follow.
strings.처음엔 이해가 되지 않을 수도 있지만…, 익숙해지실 겁니다. 앞으로 모험: You may not understand at first... but you'll get used to it. From now on, all your records will appear beneath your current chapter.
strings.이야기의 단위…입니다. 앞으로 새로운 데이터가 발견되면 확인해 보셨으면: A unit of a story. Please take a look whenever new data is discovered.
